title: Web Hosting Plans Renewal Term Rates Used in a Hosting Prefund
content:
# Renewal term rate of the prefund's plan

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts, for the hosting plan on Web Hosting Plans whose renewal a prefund deposit carries

The term rate of the prefund's plan renewal follows the term length the plan's new term will have, which is the term of a term change scheduled for the plan where one is scheduled and otherwise the plan's current term length. The price so found is the plan's renewal list price in the credit the prefund must cover.

| New term of the plan | Plan's renewal list price |
|---|---|
| 36 months | the plan tier's regular 36-month monthly rate times 36 |
| 24 months | the plan tier's regular 24-month monthly rate times 24 |
| 1 month | the plan tier's 1-month monthly price, with no setup fee |
| any other new term | the plan tier's regular 12-month monthly rate times 12 |

The new term is read from the plan's change requests (a scheduled term change and its target term) and, where none is scheduled, from the plan's current billing term.

## Hypothetical readings

- A 12-month plan with a scheduled term change to 36 months, regular 36-month rate $6.95: $6.95 times 36, $250.20.
- A 24-month plan with no scheduled change, regular 24-month rate $7.60: $7.60 times 24, $182.40.
- A 12-month plan with a scheduled change to the 1-month term, 1-month price $11.49: $11.49, with no setup fee.
